scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm just checking in on the status of my application. Could you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, I'd like to know the interest rate and total costs if it's been approved.
dialogue.agent: Your application has been denied. The record does not include an interest rate or total costs because the loan was not approved. The principal reason for denial was your debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you explain what my debt-to-income ratio means in this context? Also, are there any other reasons for the denial that I should be aware of?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. In this case, it was over 60%, which contributed to the denial of your loan application. There are no other reasons for the denial listed in the record.

dialogue.user: I understand. Is there anything I can do to improve my chances of getting approved in the future? Also, has my loan application been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include information on how to improve your chances of approval. This loan has not been sold to another institution because it was denied.

dialogue.user:
I see. Well, thank you for the information. I appreciate your help.

<Dissatisfied> The conversation was straightforward, but I'm disappointed that my application was denied due to my debt-to-income ratio. I wish there was more guidance on how to improve my chances next time.
